title: vernonanthura cronquistii
intro: Vernonanthura cronquistii, commonly known as Rio Grande or Cronquist's Vernonanthura, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is a shrubby perennial herb native to the southeastern United States and Mexico, valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Vernonanthura cronquistii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antipyretic, and expectorant effects.
